text: The John Brophy Award is given to the ECHL coach deemed to have made the greatest contribution to his team's success, as selected by the coaches of all ECHL teams. The award has been presented since 1989 and was initially called Coach Of The Year before being renamed in honor of John Brophy in 2003. John Brophy coached in the ECHL for 13 seasons and holds the league record with 575 regular and postseason wins. Bob Ferguson is the only coach to have won the award more than once, receiving it in 1999 and 2000.
